name: genpet
description: An image-generated native Codex Pet that begins as an egg and grows with local activity.

interface.shortDescription: A native pixel companion, growing with you.
interface.longDescription: Adopt an image-generated egg with /genpet-start and grow with local activity. Includes reset, growth and state debugging skills. Updates the same native Pet through background cache invalidation when the local debugging channel is available; reports display confirmation separately.
